item.title: Visalia Unified hosts roundtable talk with leaders in aftermath of photo depicting "homophobic slur"
item.description: A group of nine leaders from Valley educators, organizers from the LGBTQ+ community, and heads of local churches met at the offices of Visalia Unified on Wednesday afternoon for a closed-door conversation centered on what the school district says is focused on strengthening community through civility, accountability, and action.

item.title: 20-year-old plaintiff testifies she became addicted to social media as early as 6 in landmark trial
item.description: The woman - identified in court as KGM - is the key plaintiff in the case, which alleges she began using social media as young as age 6 and became dependent on the apps.

item.title: Teen boy accused of killing Caleb Quick returns to court, requests phone call with mom
item.description: The teen boy prosecutors say shot and killed Caleb Quick at a Clovis McDonald's last April returned to court on Thursday.

item.title: Dine and Dish: Mike's Pizzeria continues serving Fresno after more than 60 years
item.description: Mike's Pizzeria has been a Fresno favorite since 1962, serving homemade pasta, calzoni and family recipes passed down for generations.

item.title: Instagram says it will notify parents if teens 'repeatedly' search for terms related to suicide
item.description: Instagram said Thursday it will start alerting parents if their kids repeatedly search for terms clearly associated with suicide or self-harm.

item.title: Warner Bros. Discovery deems Paramount's takeover bid superior to Netflix deal
item.description: Netflix is declining to raise its offer to buy Warner Bros. Discovery's studio and streaming business.

item.title: No clear front-runner in race for California governor, new poll shows
item.description: A new poll shows there's still no clear front-runner in the race to replace Gov. Gavin Newsom.

item.title: 'Dripping in gold:' Meet the designer behind Alysa Liu's dress now part of Olympic history
item.description: After more than 100 hours of designing, sewing and hand-placed beading, a piece of gold fabric transformed into an iconic gold-medal look for Olympic figure skater Alysa Liu.

item.title: Sky Collins returns healthy for Fresno State after last season's championship injury
item.description: Diamond 'Dogs outfielder Sky Collins is back in the lineup this season, less than a year after suffering a severe ankle injury during the 2025 Mountain West championship.

item.title: Fresno councilmember plans legislation to block registered sex offenders from seeking office
item.description: Fresno city councilmember Annalisa Perea says she plans to create legislation that would prevent a registered sex offender from running for council.
